data.name: Azdil
data.gender_notes: Azdil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic 'Az-Dhil, meaning 'the lion', this name evokes the image of a mighty and powerful warrior. It is a name that inspires confidence and respect. The name Azdil carries the meaning “Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Azdil usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Azdil represents the inner strength and courage that lies within each of us, waiting to be awakened and harnessed. It is a reminder to face challenges with bravery and determination, and to trust in our abilities to overcome obstacles.
data.etymology: Azdil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azdil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أزديل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أزد و يدل على القوة و الشجاعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أزديل مشتق من أزد و هو من الأسماء التي تدل على القوة و الشجاعة في اللغة العربية، و يرتبط بمعاني الصبر و الثبات. و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل قيمة روحية و أخلاقية عالية في التقاليد الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ازدیل
in_urdu.meaning: ایک مضبوط اور بہادر شخص کے لئے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ازدیل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بہادر۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا استعمال شجاعت اور قوت کی علامت کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام روحانی مضبوطی اور کردار کی پنیری کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़दील
in_hindi.meaning: एक मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति के लिए
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़दील एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और बहादुर। यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से लिया गया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका उपयोग वीरता और शक्ति के प्रतीक के रूप में किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक दृढ़ता और चरित्र की पवित्रता का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_pashto.name: آزديل
in_pashto.meaning: د قوي او زړور سړي لپاره
in_pashto.long_meaning: آزديل د عربي نوم دی چې مطلب يې قوي او زړور دی. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی او د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دود کې د زړورتیا او قوت د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي. دا نوم د روحاني قوت او کرکتر د پاکۍ د يو سمبول په توګه منل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Azdil
in_english.long_meaning: Azdil is an Arabic name derived from the root 'azd', signifying strength, courage, and resilience. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes spiritual fortitude and moral integrity. Historically, the name Azdil has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote bravery and steadfastness. It is associated with positive personality traits such as leadership and determination.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: آزديل

data.cultural_impact: The name Azdil carries significant cultural weight in Islamic societies due to its association with courage, strength, and valor. It is a name often given to boys to instill in them the virtues of bravery and determination, inspiring them to embody these qualities in their daily lives. In Arab and Islamic cultures, lions are symbols of power, courage, and royalty, emphasizing the unique prestige this name holds among Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Azdil represents the inner strength and might that every individual possesses. When confronted with challenges and difficulties, invoking the spirit of the lion within can translate to acquiring the mental fortitude to face hardships and hold onto faith. In Hadith, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said that every believer has a true warrior within, reflecting the spiritual power found in standing up for one's beliefs and resilience in the face of adversity. By embracing this name and its spiritual significance, Azdil becomes a constant reminder of the innate inner power and courage that all Muslims possess.
